fields.new: Five more schools: OEC, Pennell, Prince Hall, Lamberton and Ellwood

Each has its own page with what runs there, what picks up from it and what’s a short walk away. New to the site are LEGACY’s free tennis-based after-school program at Overbrook Educational Center and Pennell, Right At School’s free after-school program at Prince Hall, Mural Arts’ after-school art at Lamberton and Young Achievers Learning Center’s free after-school program at Ellwood, each with the clubs and partners the school names on its own site. That makes 94 schools in all.
